reviews.text:
Dream Companion Weaknesses. Dream Companion is not recommended for those seeking a natural, immersive AI voice experience like Grok. The voice output is described as robotic, slow, and lacking in realism, with a workflow requiring manual typing, waiting, and pressing play for every response making the experience tedious and far from seamless. Both expert reviewers and users have criticized the app for basic voice quality, frequent delays, and a reliance on text instead of true, interactive voice conversation.

Voice responses sound synthetic, closer to a “bad Siri,” never matching natural
 conversation quality.

No real-time live voice calls, you must type, wait up to a minute, and then manually trigger the playback each time.
Not worth it. Basic ai modeling barely worth the download time
